statusDefinitions.active: Executable through a currently governed Pandora provider surface.
statusDefinitions.active_internal: Executable by a Pandora platform service but not necessarily public MCP.
statusDefinitions.staged_source: Implementation exists in canonical source but deployment/authorization is not fully proven.
statusDefinitions.installable: Capability schema is supported; provider connection and verification are required before execution.
statusDefinitions.owner_gate: Connection may be installable, but consequential use requires owner authorization.
statusDefinitions.privacy_gate: Use requires privacy/data-purpose authorization plus provider access.
statusDefinitions.regulated_gate: Use depends on legal/regulatory/provider requirements and explicit authorization.
statusDefinitions.provider_contract_required: No execution until a compatible provider/API contract and authority are verified.

universalPolicy.reads: least privilege and tenant-scoped provider readback
universalPolicy.writes: durable plan -> approval when required -> one-time claim -> provider execution -> readback
universalPolicy.destructive: explicit owner authorization -> exact target -> one-shot execution -> reconciliation
universalPolicy.unknownOutcome: never blind-retry; reconcile provider state first
universalPolicy.verification: important outputs require independent evidence before completion
universalPolicy.memory: only sanitized verified outcomes may be proposed; canonical Memory remains review governed
